# origincloud_location_zones (Data Source)

Lists every zone, in catalog order. A zone offers a service when its `services` names it: those are the zones a client lists that service's zonal resources in.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "origincloud_location_zones" "all" {}

# The zones that offer PVS, as a volume's `zone` names them.
locals {
  pvs_zones = [for z in data.origincloud_location_zones.all.zones : trimprefix(z.name, "zones/") if contains(z.services, "pvs")]
}

# Every zone's volumes.
data "origincloud_pvs_volumes" "each" {
  for_each = toset(local.pvs_zones)
  project  = "my-project-123"
  zone     = each.key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `zones` (Attributes List) Every zone, in catalog order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) The name the console shows, such as `EU Central 1, zone 1`.
- `name` (String) The zone's resource name, `zones/eu-central1-az1`. Its last segment is the zone in a zonal resource's name, `projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/volumes/{volume}`.
- `region` (String) The region the zone is in, `regions/{region}`.
- `services` (List of String) The services whose zonal resources the zone holds, by the name of their API, such as `pvs`: the host `{service}.origincloudapis.eu` serves them. Empty for a zone that holds none yet. A service is added here when its API is published.
